explanation: The ballot of 5 June 2011 came early and it was about the crisis. Parliament voted down the fourth austerity package in March, José Sócrates resigned, and the country voted six weeks after the request for assistance, under a memorandum the two largest opposition parties had already signed. The confidence is `probable` because an early election always has more than one immediate cause. The other one here is the arithmetic of the minority government returned in 2009, and the atlas already draws that line to the bailout.
